# Code of Conduct

## Purpose

This project is a school-related project about AI scyophancy. Everyone contributing to or participating in the project is expected to follow these rules to ensure that work remains honest and representative of the student's own understanding.

## Rules

### Do your own work

All code, writing, and research schould be created by the student. Any code or writing not done as such needs to be documents and cited with a comment.

### Do not use AI to write code

AI tools such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Claude, Gemini, etc. should not be used to generate this project's code.

AI may be utilized where required by the client.

### Acknowledgment

By contributing to this project, participants agree to follow these rules and represent their work with honesty.
